name: zeithub-otto
description: zeithub.otto — local AI coding studio (Ollama, desktop + web)
author: zeithub.team

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k -n web,app -c magenta,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev -w @otto/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:i18n && npm run check:alpha && npm run test
